spells.statistics: Energy Reserve (Magical; Special Recharge, -70%) [0.9/level]. Note: This variant of Special Recharge requires an IQ roll, witnessing a critical failure, but does not require any extra advantages.

spells.casting_roll: None. Use DX or unarmed combat skill to hit.
spells.description: The sorcerer must touch a manufactured weapon in its sheath, holder, quiver, or whatever object is used to hold it when not in use. This spell makes the weapon stuck in its holder.
spells.statistics: Affliction 1 (HT; Accessibility, Only sheathed weapons, -50%; Extended Duration, 100x, +80%; Fixed Duration, +0%; Melee Attack, Reach C, -30%; No Signature, +20%; Paralysis, Variant, +150%; Sorcery, -15%; Terminal Condition, Being attacked, -5%) [25].

spells.duration: Indefinite. Air, smoke, and other gases are like solid ground beneath your feet, allowing you to walk up and down “invisible stairs” at your ground Move, but no higher than 5 feet from the ground. This won’t work in a vacuum – there has to be some kind of air present. If you get knocked down or slip, you fall!
spells.description: Air, smoke, and other gases are like solid ground beneath your feet, allowing you to walk up and down invisible stairs at your ground Move, but no higher than 5 feet from the ground. This won’t work in a vacuum – there has to be some kind of air present.
spells.statistics: Walk on Air (Maximum Height, 5 feet, -25%; Sorcery, -15%) [12].

spells.description: The subject of this spell becomes anchored to the plane of existence he is currently on. He becomes unable to plane shift voluntarily or involuntarily.
spells.statistics: Affliction 1 (Will; Advantage, Phase Trap, +270%; Based on Will, +20%; Fixed Duration, +0%; Malediction 2, +150%; No Signature, +20%; Sorcery, -15%) [55]. Note: “Phase Trap” is Static (Plane Shifting; Magical, -10%) [27].

spells.description: This working is a limited version of the Create Planar Gate spell. For this spell to work, two identical portal arches must be built on different planes of existence.
spells.statistics: Jumper (Interplanar; Anchored, Single Fixed Site, -80%; Cosmic, Do not have to visit the other side, +50%; Extended Duration, 30x, +60%; Extra Carrying Capacity, Extra-Heavy, +50%; Improved, +10%; Magical, ‑10%; Special Portal, Prebuilt Portal, -60%; Tunnel, Before, +100%) [220]. Each additional level adds Area Effect (+50%) [+50]. Note: The Improved enhancement removes the auto-fail on 14+.

spells.casting_roll: IQ; Special casting time and FP cost.
spells.description: This working is a limited version of the Create Gate spell. For this spell to work, two identical portal arches must be built.
spells.statistics: Warp (Anchored, Single Fixed Site, -80%; Cosmic, Do not have to visit the other side and no removal penalties, +50%; Extended Duration, 30x, +60%; Extra Carrying Capacity, Extra-Heavy, +50%; Requires Concentrate, -15%; Sorcery, -15%; Special Portal, Prebuilt Portal, -60%; Tunnel, Before, +100%) [190]. Each additional level adds Area Effect (+50%) [+50].

spells.description: With this spell the caster is able to transfer an exact image, including colors, of a specific scene into a sphere of crystal or glass. The glass sphere must weigh no more than 10 x (level squared) lbs.
spells.statistics: Control Glass (Accessibility, Only to capture scenes into crystal spheres, -80%; Sorcery, -15%) [2/level].

spells.casting_roll: None. Use Innate Attack (Gaze) to aim.
spells.description: This working strengthens the soul’s connection to the body. First, the subject becomes immune to death curses.
spells.statistics: Affliction 1 (HT; Advantage, Preservation, +540%; Extended Duration, 10x, +40%; Fixed Duration, +0%; Increased 1/2D, 10x, +15%; No Signature, +20%; Sorcery, -15%) [70]. Note: “Preservation” is Immunity to Death Curses (Magical, -10%) [9] + Unkillable 1 (Magical, -10%) [45].

spells.description: This working creates an immaterial Energy Reserve. The size of the Energy Reserve is equal to Raise Cone of Power level x 10.
spells.statistics: Energy Reserve 10 (Magical; Affects Others 1, +50%; Area Effect, 2 yards, +50%; Requires IQ Roll from the User, -10%) [57/level] + Regeneration (Regular; Accessibility, Only with 2 assistants, -10%; ER Only, -0%; Magical, -10%; Nuisance Effect, Energy is restored at the end of one hour regardless of the number of assistants, -5%; Reduced Time 1, Limited by Accessibility, Only with 6 assistants (-20%), +18%; Reduced Time 1, Limited by Accessibility, Only with 11 assistants (-25%), +15%; Reduced Time 1, Limited by Accessibility, Only with 21 assistants (-30%), +14%; Requires Concentrate, -15%) [27]. Note: This spell originally appeared in GURPS Thaumatology.

spells.duration: Indefinite. Undead who flee will remain affected for 15 hours.
spells.description: This working creates a powerful compulsion within undead creatures, prompting them to avoid the caster. Every undead creature in the area must roll against Will+DR every second; this is an unopposed roll, not a Quick Contest.
spells.statistics: Affliction 1 (HT; Accessibility, Undead only, -50%; Area Effect, 2 yards, +50%; Aura, +80%; Based on Will, +20%; Disadvantage, Dread, +30%; Extended Duration, 300x, +100%; Fixed Duration, +0%; Melee Attack, Reach C, -30%; No Signature, +20%; Sorcery, -15%; Variable, Area, +5%) [31]. Additional levels add Area Effect (+50%) [+5].

spells.description: While this spell is active, the caster can reflect incoming missiles back to the attackers. When the caster is targeted by a ranged attack, they may roll to cast this spell as an active defense.
spells.statistics: Damage Resistance 7 (Active Defense, -40%; All-or-Nothing, ‑10%; Force Field, +20%; Limited, Ranged, ‑20%; Reflection, +100%; Sorcery, -15%) [47.25/level] with each DR 7 converted into 2d per p. B269. The ruling on Affliction and Binding is from p. 168 of GURPS Powers.

spells.casting_roll: Per. Use Innate Attack (Gaze) to aim.
spells.description: When cast on an area, this spell reveals magical auras for everyone to see. Each magical aura gives off light equivalent to a torch.
spells.statistics: Detect (Magic; Area Effect, 2 yards, +50%; Cannot Analyze, -10%; Extended Duration, 10x, +40%; Persistent, +40%; Precise, +100%; Ranged, +40%; Reflexive, +40%; Sorcery, -15%; Visible, -10%) [38]. Additional levels add Area Effect (+50%) [+5].

spells.casting_roll: None. Use Innate Attack (Gaze) or Artillery (Bombs) to hit.
spells.description: You conjure a boulder above the ground and drop it at a single target. Use the better of Innate Attack (Gaze) and Artillery (Bombs) to hit, applying normal range penalties.
spells.statistics: Crushing Attack 1d (Increased 1/2D, 10x, +15%; No Knockback, -10%; Overhead, +30%; Sorcery, -15%) [6/level].

spells.description: The caster creates a double of himself woven from shadowstuff. The double possesses the caster’s full knowledge and mundane powers (it cannot cast spells, use psionics, use magical abilities, etc.), but no gear.
spells.statistics: Duplication 1 (Accessibility, Mundane abilities, -10%; Construct, +60%; Cosmic, Origin of spells, limited by Vision-Based, Reversed, +40%; Sorcery, -15%) [62].

spells.casting_roll: IQ, additional IQ to cross the Plane of Shadow; Special casting time and FP cost.
spells.description: To use the Shadow Walk spell, you must be in an area of shadowy illumination. You and anything you carry (including other creatures) are then transported along a coiling path of shadowstuff to the edge of the Material Plane where it borders the Plane of Shadow.

spells.casting_roll: None. Use Innate Attack (Beam) to hit.
spells.description: You fire a cone of metal shards that do 1d cutting damage per level. The spell spreads to affect everyone in a cone-shaped area.
spells.statistics: Cutting Attack 1d (Cone 5, +100%; Increased 1/2D, x2, +5%; Reduced Range, 1/10, -30%; Sorcery, -15%) [11.2/level].

spells.casting_roll: Will. Use Hearing to notice threats.
spells.duration: Eight hours. Record the sorcerer’s margin of success when casting the spell. When anybody walks by or touches a plant in the area, they must roll against DX at a penalty equal to that margin. Success allows the subject to move freely for one second, after which he must roll again. The moment he fails, a breeze through the leaves makes a whistling sound: +10 on all Hearing rolls (p. B358) to notice his movement! The noisiness lasts until the subject leaves the area. Alternatively, he may remain within and stand perfectly still for three full minutes, after which the effect “resets” and he’s able to make DX rolls again to sneak by. If the subject is masked by magical silence, roll a Quick Contest using the sorcerer’s Will. If this spell wins, the magical silence is ignored; if it ties or loses, Singing Trees has no effect on that subject.
spells.description: Record the sorcerer’s margin of success when casting the spell. When anybody walks by or touches a plant in the area, they must roll against DX at a penalty equal to that margin.
spells.statistics: Affliction 1 (DX; Area Effect, 2 yards, +50%; Based on DX, +20%; Disadvantage, Noisy 5, +10%; Environmental, Vegetation, -20%; Extended Duration on Persistent, 3,000x, +140%; Fixed Duration, +0%; Malediction 2, +150%; No Signature, +20%; Persistent, +40%; Sorcery, -15%; Terminal Condition, Leaving the area, -20%; Variable, Area, +5%) [48]. Additional levels add Area Effect (+50%) [+5].

spells.description: This working creates a solid hook of magical force, invisible to all but the caster, at a desired location. The hook need not be attached to anything, and is usually created in midair over a pit or chasm.
spells.statistics: Telekinesis 19 (Fixed Duration, +0%; Independent, +40%; Lift Only, -20%; One Task, Suspending, -60%; Sorcery, -15%) [43].

spells.casting_roll: None. Use Innate Attack (Gaze) to aim.
spells.description: This working creates a smoky, immobile cloud in which black, whiplike whorls of deeper darkness appear and disappear. They have only momentary solidity, yet they slice as if they were unbreakable, razor-sharp ribbons of steel.
spells.statistics: Cutting Attack 1d-2 (Area Effect, 2 yards, +50%; Link, +10%; Magical, -10%; Persistent, +40%; Variable, Area, +5%) [6] + Obscure Vision 5 (Extended, Infravision and Ultravision, +40%; Link, +10%; Ranged, +50%; Sorcery, -15%; Variable, Area, +5%) [19]. Further levels add Area Effect (+50%) to the advantages [+6.5*]. * Calculate the total cost, then round up.

spells.description: The caster may steal HP from a victim to replenish your own. You must be able to see your victim with your unaided sight while stealing his life.
spells.statistics: Leech 1 (Accelerated Healing, +25%; Based on HT, +20%; Malediction 2, +150%; Ranged, +40%; Sorcery, -15%; Vision-Based, Reversed, -20%) [75 + 12/additional level].

spells.description: When this spell is active, the caster can attempt to cast this spell as an active defense, when somebody casts a spell that affects them or their personal equipment directly. Thus, Sovereign Ward does not protect against missile spells.
spells.statistics: Static (Magic; Active Defense, -40%; Sorcery, -15%; Switchable, +100%) [44] + Rules Exemption (Magical abilities can coexist with anti-magical Static) [1]. Notes: Active Defense being IQ-based is a special feature. This spell originally appeared in GURPS Magical Styles: Dungeon Magic.

spells.casting_roll: None. Use unarmed combat skill or DX to hit.
spells.description: This working charges the caster’s hand with a powerful electric charge. Touching the subject deals 1d corrosion surge damage to it, as matter erodes away.
spells.statistics: Corrosion Attack 1d (Melee Attack, Reach C, Cannot Parry, -35%; Sorcery, -15%; Surge, +20%) [7/level].

spells.description: You create a set of triggering conditions for a scroll that bears a spell that you could have cast yourself, i.e. that is within the scope of your Sorcerous Empowerment and that costs no more than your Sorcerous Empowerment. The spell must be one that affects your person.
spells.statistics: Cosmic Power 10 (Limited, One Spell Phylactery Package, -50%; Magical, -10%) [40]. Notes: “Spell Phylactery Package” is Attribute Substitution (Power Techniques based on IQ) [1] + Extra Option (Power techniques for enchanted items) [1] + Supernatural Delay (H) IQ [11] + Unusual Training (Supernatural Delay power technique for sorcery spells; only spells that you could have cast yourself) [1] modified with Accessibility, Only spells that affect the caster, -20%; Accessibility, Only if the scroll is strapped to the arm or forehead, -10%; Accessibility, Only scrolls, -50%; Cosmic, Does not actually cast the spell before it is triggered, +50%; Reduced Fatigue Cost 1, +20%; Magical, -10%; Terminal Condition, Not worn for 24 hours or given to another person, -10% for a final cost of 10 points.

spells.description: This working creates a link between a touched spider and the caster. This link allows the caster to see through the eyes of the aforementioned spider, and the visual feed is translated to the caster, because spiders usually have eight eyes.
spells.statistics: Affliction 1 (IQ; Accessibility, Spiders Only, -50%; Advantage, Spidereyes, +240%; Based on IQ, +20%; Extended Duration, x1,000, +120%; Fixed Duration, +0%; Malediction 1, +100%; Melee Attack, Reach C, -30%; No Signature, +20%; Sorcery, -15%) [51]. Note: “Spidereyes” is Telesend (Accessibility, Only the caster, -80%; Always On, -10%; Cosmic, No die roll required, +100%; Magical, -10%; Video Only, -20%) [24].

spells.description: Each time you cast this, you coagulate planar energies to create a creature that resembles an outsider (worth 75% or less of your point value) from a particular plane of existence (chosen when you pick this spell). You cannot create a specific being using this spell.
spells.statistics: Ally (A type of outsiders; Built on 75%; Constantly; Adjustable, +50%; Conjured, +100%; Minion, +50%; Sorcery, -15%; Special Abilities, +50%) [41]. Lesser Summon Monster has Ally, built on 25%. Greater Summon Monster is built on 100%.

spells.description: Each time you cast this, you use negative energy to create an undead creature (worth 25% or less of your point value). You cannot create a specific being using this spell.
spells.statistics: Ally (Undead; Built on 25%; Constantly; Adjustable, +100%; Conjured, +100%; Minion, +50%; Sorcery, -15%; Special Abilities, +50%) [16].

spells.duration: Indefinite. After concentrating for one minute, the sorcerer creates a floating replica of an eye that they can see through. The casting roll takes the range penalties given under Long-Distance Modifiers (p. B241). If the caster cannot see the casting point, but can specify direction and distance to it, the casting roll is at ‑5. On failure by 1, the spell creates the Wizard Eye in another valid location of the GM’s choosing. The sorcerer cannot change the eye’s position and facing without recasting the spell. However, while inside a moving object, the Wizard Eye will move with that object with no special concentration on the user’s part. The eye functions as an extension of the sorcerer’s body, allowing it to deliver spells that require a touch (although, that is difficult, considering the fact that the eye is immobile) or act as the origination point of ranged spells. For the purpose of range-dependent abilities (e.g., spells cast on or by the sorcerer), use the shortest of the range from their body and from the Wizard Eye. In combat, the sorcerer specifies whether they’re giving priority to natural sight or the Wizard Eye at the start of each turn. All tasks that depend on the deprioritized sight source are at ‑4, including casting rolls. Voluntarily moving the Wizard Eye automatically gives it priority. Wizard Eye can be attacked and destroyed. Treat it as an SM-9 object with no DR (regardless of the user’s natural DR) and HP equal to the caster’s HP/10. Should the eye be destroyed, the sorcerer loses the ability to cast this spell for five minutes.
spells.description: After concentrating for one minute, the sorcerer creates a floating replica of an eye that they can see through. The casting roll takes the range penalties given under Long-Distance Modifiers.
spells.statistics: Clairsentience (Aware, +50%; Breakable, DR 0, SM-9, ‑20%; Clairvoyance, ‑10%; Cosmic, The eye is considered to be a part of the caster’s body for the purpose of range-dependent abilities and spell delivery, +50%; Fixed Range, ‑5%; Increased Range, 2,000,000x, +190%; No Strain, +25%; Nuisance Effect, Cannot concentrate to move the eye or change facing, -10%; Short-Range 1, -10%; Sorcery, ‑15%; Visible, ‑10%) [168]. Note: The No Strain enhancement was borrowed from Warp. * Unlimited range assumes a global range on an Earth-like world. The actual range is 20,000,000 yards or 11,363 miles.

spells.description: This working modifies the functioning of all teleportation spells and spell-like abilities into, out of, and within its area (each casting covers an area of its spell level yards in radius).
spells.statistics: Control Teleportation Magic 1 (Accessibility, Only to redirect, -60%; Extended Duration, Permanent, +150%; Nuisance Effect, Cannot exempt people from effects, -5%; Persistent, +40%; Ranged, +40%; Sorcery, -15%) [25] + Control Teleportation Magic +1 (Accessibility, Only to redirect, -60%; Does not increase area of effect, -50%; Extended Duration, Permanent, +150%; Nuisance Effect, Cannot exempt people from effects, -5%; Persistent, +40%; Ranged, +40%; Sorcery, -15%) [20]. Additional levels add Control Teleportation Magic +1 (Accessibility, Only to redirect, -60%; Extended Duration, Permanent, +150%; Nuisance Effect, Cannot exempt people from effects, -5%; Only increases area of effect, -50%; Persistent, +40%; Ranged, +40%; Sorcery, -15%) [20/level]. Notes: Redirecting is treated as an effect that requires two levels of Control, as if using Neutralize with Derange. As this is one advantage (Control Teleportation Magic) with the Sorcery limitation, not two, it costs only 1 FP to use.

spells.description: You exit the time stream along with equipment up to your No Encumbrance limit. You may hurry the casting, but your roll will be at -1 per second of concentration omitted (-10 to cast with no preparation at all).
spells.statistics: Jumper (Time Stop; Improved, +10%; Magical, ‑10%; Maximum Duration, 1 hour, -10%) [90]. Note: The Improved enhancement removes the auto-fail on 14+. This Jumper variant originally appeared in Designer’s Notes: GURPS Powers, pyramid.sjgames.com/sample. html?id=5782.

spells.casting_roll: IQ; Special casting time and FP cost.
spells.description: This working teleports the caster to the central fountain of a city or town the caster has visited before. After the caster teleports, he creates a gate behind him that persists for 3d seconds.
spells.statistics: Warp (Anchored, Nearest town with a central fountain that you have visited before, -50%; Extra Carrying Capacity, Extra-Heavy, +50%; Requires Concentrate, -15%; Sorcery, -15%; Tunnel, After, +40%) [110]. Note: The improved version replaces Anchored, Nearest town with a central fountain that you have visited before, -50% with Anchored, Town with a central fountain that you have visited before, -30% [+20].

spells.casting_roll: IQ. Use Innate Attack (Gaze) to aim. Special casting time and cost.
spells.range: 100 yards to the origin point. Unlimited to the destination point.
spells.description: This working teleports a volume of water leading to another place you are able to see with your own eyes, or view remotely, or visualize clearly (which is only possible if you have visited it previously in person). You may make the volume of water teleport gradually at a set rate instead of teleporting all at once.
spells.statistics: Affliction 1 (HT; Accessibility, Only to move water, -30%; Advantage, Transfer Water 1, +200%; Increased 1/2D, x10, +15%; May set the rate of transfer, +10%; No Signature, +20%; Sorcery, -15%) [30]. Note: “Transfer Water 1” is Warp (Accessibility, Only downhill, -50%; Exoteleport, -50%; Magical, -10%; Modified Capacity, Static, 120 lbs., +30%) [20]. Each additional level improves Modified Capacity, Static by one step (+5%) [+5].

spells.description: This working permanently removes transfers a part of a living creature’s magical essence to the caster. The caster must perform a ritual that lasts one hour.
spells.statistics: Affliction 1 (HT; Accessibility, Self Only, -50%; Cumulative, +400%; Extended Duration, Truly Permanent, +300%; Immediate Preparation Required, 1 hour, -75%; Nuisance Effect, Magery loss on critical failure, -10%; Requires a Quick Contest of IQ vs. Will + Magery, -15%; Sorcery, -15%; Special Enhancement 1, +80%; Trigger, Killing a living creature with magical abilities, -60%) [66]. Notes: The victim adding their Magery level to their resistance roll is a special feature. Each level of Special Enhancement is Variable Enhancement, Any 1-point trait, Only magical abilities (-20%), +80%. Each additional level adds further Special Enhancement (+80%) [+8].

spells.description: While this spell is active, the caster can create a momentary force to twist blades that strike them. For the purpose of this spell a blade is any melee weapon being used in a manner that inflicts cutting damage.
spells.statistics: Damage Resistance 10 (Accessibility, Only to disarm, not break, ‑20%; Active Defense, -40%; Limited, Cutting blades, ‑60%; Link, +10%; Provides no DR, ‑100%; Reflection, Variant, +100%; Sorcery, -15%) [10] + Injury Tolerance (Damage Reduction 1.5; Active Defense, -40%; Limited, Cutting blades, ‑60%; Link, +10%; Magical, ‑10%) [5]. As a special effect, the reduced damage is treated as crushing for all purposes. The damage-to-disarm rule unifies those from p. 11 of GURPS Gun Fu and p. B401. Injury Tolerance 1.5 has a base cost of 25 points, by induction.

spells.description: You attempt to unravel summoning magic that holds a creature in this world. Roll a Quick Contest of your Will versus the subject’s Will.
spells.statistics: Affliction 1 (Will; Accessibility, Only on summoned beings, -30%; Based on Will, +20%; Heart Attack, Variant, +300%; Malediction 2, +150%; No Signature, +20%; Sorcery, ‑15%) [55].

spells.casting_roll: None. Use Innate Attack (Gaze) to aim.

spells.casting_roll: None. Use Innate Attack (Gaze) to aim.

spells.casting_roll: None. Use Innate Attack (Gaze) to aim.
spells.description: This working makes birth painless and trouble-free.
spells.statistics: Affliction 1 (HT; Accessibility, Only on pregnant women, -80%; Advantage, Ease Labor, +50%; Extended Duration, 1,000x, +120%; Fixed Duration, +0%; Increased 1/2D, 10x, +15%; No Signature, +20%; Sorcery, -15%) [21]. spells.casting_roll: None. Use Innate Attack (Gaze) to aim.
spells.description: The subject is surrounded by a horizontal barrier of transparent blades of force. Everyone adjacent to the subject or in close combat with the subject is attacked each second with an effective skill of 14, modified only for size.

spells.statistics: Burning Attack 1d (Cone 5, +100%; Increased 1/2D, x2, +5%; Reduced Range, 1/10, -30%; Sorcery, -15%) [8/level].

spells.description: The caster throws a tiny ball of fire that stays in the point of impact for some time, and then expands to cover an area; it is not technically an explosion, but the term has long since entered common use. Use Innate Attack (Projectile) to hit, applying normal range penalties, but at +4 for targeting an area.
spells.statistics: Burning Attack (Area Effect, 4 yards, +100%; Delay, Variable, Long, +20%; Nuisance Effect, Dangerous to be parried, -5%; Sorcery, -15%) [10/level].

spells.casting_roll: None. Use DX or unarmed combat skill to hit.
spells.description: The caster touches a surface, casting magical runes into being. When read by anyone you did not specify during casting, the runes explode.
spells.statistics: Crushing Attack (Affects Insubstantial, +20%; Area Effect, 4 yards, +100%; Melee Attack, Reach C, Cannot Parry, -35%; Triggered Delay, Reading, +50%; Selective Effect, +20%; Sorcery, -15%) [12/level].

spells.casting_roll: None. Use DX or unarmed combat skill to hit.
spells.description: The caster touches an object that can be opened (a book, a chest, a door, etc.) and create a fire trap. When the object is opened by anyone not specified during the casting, the trap explodes. Everyone within four yards of the trap takes dice of burning damage equal to your level of this spell.
spells.statistics: Burning Attack (Area Effect, 4 yards, +100%; Melee Attack, Reach C, Cannot Parry, -35%; Triggered Delay, Opening, +50%; Selective Effect, +20%; Sorcery, -15%) [11/level].

spells.casting_roll: None. Use Innate Attack (Gaze) to hit.
spells.description: When outdoors, you can cause a pillar of flame to strike your target, dealing 2d burning damage per level. The target takes damage normally; anything nearby receives collateral damage equal to basic damage divided by the distance in yards from the blast.
spells.statistics: Burning Attack 2d (Environmental, Outdoors, -20%; Explosion 3, +150%; Overhead, +30%; Sorcery, -15%) [24.5/level*]. * Calculate the total cost, then round up.

spells.casting_roll: None. Use Innate Attack (Projectile) to «lock on».
spells.description: A sphere of flame flies off your fingertips and bounces along the floor towards your target. A successful hit does 1d burning damage per level of this spell.
spells.statistics: Burning Attack 1d (Environmental, Along the floor, -15%; Guided, +50%; Reduced Range, x1/2, -10%; Sorcery, -15%) [5.5/level*]. * Calculate the total cost then round up.

spells.casting_roll: None. Use Innate Attack (Projectile) to hit.
spells.description: The caster throws a ball of cold that expands to cover an area; it is not technically an explosion, but the term has long since entered common use. Use Innate Attack (Projectile) to hit, applying normal range penalties, but at +4 for targeting an area.
spells.statistics: Burning Attack 3d (Area Effect, 4 yards, +100%; Link, +10%; Magical, -10%; No Incendiary Effect, -10%; Nuisance Effect, Dangerous to be parried, -5%; Side Effect, DX-2 and Numb, +90%) [42] + Binding 10 (Area Effect, 4 yards, +100%; Environmental, Water, -20%; Link, +10%; Sorcery, -15%) [35].

spells.casting_roll: None. Use Innate Attack (Beam) to hit.
spells.description: You fire a white ray of cold at a single target. Use Innate Attack (Beam) to hit, applying normal range penalties.
spells.statistics: Burning Attack (No Incendiary Effect, -10%; Nuisance Effect, Dangerous to be parried, -5%; Side Effect, DX-2 and Numb, +90%; Sorcery, -15%) [8/level].

spells.casting_roll: None. Use Innate Attack (Gaze) to aim.
spells.description: This working optimizes the subject’s musculature for squeezing, granting the subject the Constriction Attack advantage.
spells.statistics: Affliction 1 (HT; Advantage, Bear Hug, +140%; Fixed Duration, +0%; Increased 1/2D, 10x, +15%; No Signature, +20%; Sorcery, -15%) [26]. Note: “Bear Hug” is Constriction Attack (Magical, -10%) [14].

spells.casting_roll: None. Use Innate Attack (Gaze) to aim.
spells.description: The subject’s lungs can adapt to great pressure, permitting him to breathe unhindered (and avoid the bends) at up to 10 atmospheres. This allows him to travel as deep as 12.5 miles underground.
spells.statistics: Affliction 1 (HT; Advantage, Breath Adaptation, +30%; Extended Duration, 10x, +40%; Fixed Duration, +0%; Increased 1/2D, 10x, +15%; No Signature, +20%; Sorcery, -15%) [19]. Note: “Breath Adaptation” is Pressure Support 1 (Accessibility, Not under water, -30%; Magical, -10%) [3].

spells.casting_roll: None. Use Innate Attack (Gaze) to aim.
spells.description: The subject subtracts five yards from a fall automatically, if their body and limbs are free to move and twist (treat this as an automatic Acrobatics success – don’t check again for it). In addition, a successful DX roll halves damage from any fall.
spells.statistics: Affliction 1 (HT; Advantage, Catfall, +90%; Fixed Duration, +0%; Increased 1/2D, 10x, +15%; No Signature, +20%; Sorcery, -15%) [21]. Note: “Catfall” is Catfall (Magical, -10%) [9].

spells.description: The subject’s girth temporarily increases by one level, going from Skinny to Normal, from Normal to Overweight, from Overweight to Fat, or from Fat to Very Fat, as applicable.
spells.statistics: Affliction 1 (HT; Disadvantage, Very Fat, +5%; Fixed Duration, +0%; Malediction 2, +150%; No Signature, +20%; One category shift only, -20%; Sorcery, ‑15%) [24].

spells.description: The subject becomes suffer a heart attack.
spells.statistics: Affliction 1 (HT; Heart Attack, +300%; Malediction 2, +150%; No Signature, +20%; Sorcery, ‑15%) [56].

spells.casting_roll: Will. Use DX or unarmed combat skills to hit.
spells.description: The caster must touch the subject to trigger this spell. Armor does not protect.
spells.statistics: Crushing Attack 1d (Based on HT, +20%; Melee Attack, Reach C, Cannot Parry -35%; Malediction 1, +100%; No Knockback, -10%; No Signature, +20%; Sorcery, ‑15%) [9/level].

spells.casting_roll: None. Use Innate Attack (Gaze) to aim.
spells.description: The subject’s head comes off! When this spell is cast, the subject’s head (or one of them, if the subject has several) comes free of its body, but continues to live on its own.
spells.statistics: Affliction 1 (HT; Advantage, Decapitation, +550%; Extended Duration, Permanent, Until reattached, +150%; Fixed Duration, +0%; Increased 1/2D, 10x, +15%; No Signature, +20%; Sorcery, -15%) [82]. Note: “Decapitation” is Injury Tolerance (Independent Body Parts; Cosmic, Voluntary, +50%; Detachable Head, +15%; Instant Reattachment, +50%; Magical, -10%; Partial, Head Only, -50%) [55].

spells.casting_roll: None. Use Innate Attack (Gaze) to aim.
spells.description: You make one of the subject’s arms more dexterous compared to the rest of their body. This increases the DX of one arm chosen at the time of casting by the caster by 1 per level of this spell (up to the maximum of 4).
spells.statistics: Affliction 1 (HT; Advantage, Dexterous Arm 1, +110%; Fixed Duration, +0%; Increased 1/2D, 10x, +15%; No Signature, +20%; Sorcery, -15%) [23]. Additional levels add further Dexterous Arm to the Advantage enhancement (+110%) [+11]. Note: Each level of “Dexterous Arm” is Arm DX 1 (One Arm; Magical, -10%) [11].

spells.casting_roll: IQ. Use DX or unarmed combat skills to hit.
spells.description: If the subject fails to resist, he takes 1d toxic damage per level of this spell, ignoring DR. This spell only works on living creatures.
spells.statistics: Toxic Attack 1d (Based on HT, +20%; Based on IQ, Own Roll, +20%; Malediction 1, +100%; Melee Attack, Reach C, -30%; No Signature, +20%; Sorcery, -15%) [9/level].

spells.description: If the subject fails to resist, he takes a -10 penalty to DX for the next DX-based roll he’s going to make during the next second. This spell may be used instantly in response to at attack; in this case the DX penalty applies to the attack roll.
spells.statistics: Affliction 1 (DX; Attribute Penalty, DX-10, +100%; Based on DX, +20%; Fixed Duration, +0%; Malediction 2, +150%; No Signature, +20%; Reduced Duration, 1/180, -40%; Reflexive, +40%; Sorcery, -15%) [38].

spells.description: The subject is temporarily emaciated, losing one level of weight (up to Skinny). Armor and clothing hangs on the subject, hampering him (-2 DX).
spells.statistics: Affliction 1 (HT; Disadvantage, Skinny, +5%; Fixed Duration, +0%; Malediction 2, +150%; No Signature, +20%; One category shift only, -20%; Sorcery, ‑15%) [24].

spells.duration: Permanent until cut or until falls out naturally. Causes the subject’s hair and nails to grow at a faster rate. If left unchecked, such growth interferes with vision (as hair falls in the eyes; penalty up to -4 to Vision), movement (as the subject trips on his beard; slows Move to x0.6) and handling ability (as nails get in the way; penalty up to -4 to DX). Some bald people appreciate this spell, while it lasts (baldness returns within about a month as the hair falls out naturally). The caster may cause the spell to affect only a particular body part, and may choose the desired length of hair and nails, determining the penalties, if any. Should the hair be cut, it vanishes, so this spell is not very useful when shearing sheep.
spells.description: Permanent until cut or until falls out naturally. Causes the subject’s hair and nails to grow at a faster rate.
spells.statistics: Affliction 1 (HT; Attribute Penalty, DX-4, +40%; Attribute Penalty, Per-4, +20%; Extended Duration, Permanent, +150%; Fixed Duration, +0%; Malediction 2, +150%; No Signature, +20%; Selective Effect, +20%; Slower Move, x0.6, +20%; Sorcery, ‑15%; Variable, +5%) [51].

spells.casting_roll: None. Use Innate Attack (Gaze) to aim.
spells.description: The subject ignores shock, knockdown, physical stun, physical torture, and painful or stunning afﬂictions.
spells.statistics: Affliction 1 (HT;Advantage, Resist Pain, +270%; Fixed Duration, +0%; Increased 1/2D, 10x, +15%; No Signature, +20%; Sorcery, -15%) [39]. Note: “Resist Pain” is Immunity to Pain (Magical, -10%) [27].

spells.description: The subject temporarily gains the Low Pain Threshold disadvantage.
spells.statistics: Affliction 1 (HT; Disadvantage, Low Pain Threshold, +10%; Fixed Duration, +0%; Malediction 2, +150%; No Signature, +20%; Sorcery, ‑15%) [27].

spells.description: The subject becomes nauseated for 1 minute. This is a Body Control and a Mind Control spell.
spells.statistics: Affliction 1 (HT; Nauseated, +30%; Fixed Duration, +0%; Malediction 2, +150%; No Signature, +20%; Reduced Duration, 1/3, -10%; Sorcery, ‑15%) [28]. Note: When used as a Mind Control spell, add Accessibility, Only on sapient beings, -10% to Affliction. This makes the spell cost 27 points.

spells.casting_roll: None. Use Innate Attack (Gaze) to aim.
spells.description: You make one of the subject’s arms more strong compared to the rest of their body. This increases the ST of one arm chosen at the time of casting by the caster by 1 per level of this spell.
spells.statistics: Affliction 1 (HT; Advantage, Strong Arm 1, +30%; Fixed Duration, +0%; Increased 1/2D, 10x, +15%; No Signature, +20%; Sorcery, -15%) [15]. Additional levels add further Strong Arm to the Advantage enhancement [+2.7]. Note: Each level of “Strong Arm” is Arm ST 1 (One Arm; Magical, -10%) [2.7].

spells.description: The caster may devour the knowledge of a written work, effectively reading a book remotely. The caster must be able to see or touch the book to absorb it.
spells.statistics: Mind Reading (Accessibility, Only on books, -50%; Nuisance Effect, Writing disappears, -5%; Sorcery, -15%) [9].

spells.duration: One period of sleep. Cast on a particular book, scroll, or other written work the caster is touching before he goes to sleep, this creates a dream analog of the work, which he may continue to read as he sleeps and dreams. This can allow the caster to count sleep time as study time.
spells.description: For a single period of sleep, the caster reads a dreamed copy of a touched book, scroll, or like text and may count that sleep as study.
spells.statistics: Mind Reading (Accessibility, Only on books, -50%; Accessibility, Only when going to sleep, -30%; Extended Duration, 1,000x, +120%; Independent, +40%; Maximum Duration, One night, -5%; Melee Attack, Reach C, -30%; Sorcery, -15%) [39].

spells.description: This seals a book so that its cover cannot be opened unless the opener touches it and speaks a particular password that is selected when the spell is cast. The password must be one that appears within the pages of the book itself.
spells.statistics: Affliction 1 (HT; Accessibility, Only books, -50%; Extended Duration, Permanent, +150%; Melee Attack, Reach C, -30%; No Signature, +20%; Nuisance Effect, Can be overcome by Lockmaster, -5%; Paralysis, Variant, +150%; Sorcery, -15%) [32].

spells.casting_roll: None. Use Innate Attack (Gaze) to aim.
spells.description: This working enchants a book so that a person who reads even a word inside it will feel a strong compulsion to continue studying it until he has read the entire thing. It has no effect on someone who cannot comprehend the language the book is written in.
spells.statistics: Affliction 1 (HT; Accessibility, Only on books, -50%; Advantage, Compulsive Reader, +340%; Extended Duration, Permanent, +150%; Fixed Duration, +0%; Increased 1/2D, 10x, +15%; No Signature, +20%; Sorcery, -15%) [56]. Note: “Compulsive Reader” is Affliction 1 (Will; Aura, +80%; Based on Will, +20%; Disadvantage, Compulsive Reading (No self-control, x2.5), +13%; Extended Duration, Permanent, +150%; Melee Attack, Reach C, -30%; No Signature, +20%; Vision-Based, Variant, -20%) [34].

spells.description: This working causes the subject’s awareness of a single fact or event to become confused. Every time the subject thinks or talks about the event, he will need to make a successful roll against Will to be sure that what he remembers isn’t a dream, and to keep the details consistent.
spells.statistics: Affliction 1 (Will; Accessibility, One fact at a time, -10%; Based on Will, +20%; Disadvantage, Total Amnesia, +25%; Extended Duration, Permanent, +150%; Limited, Inconsistency, -50%; Malediction 2, +150%; No Signature, +20%; Selective Effect, +20%; Sorcery, ‑15%) [41].

spells.description: The caster may turn paper into the magical essence of paper. Success means you transform the matter successfully.
spells.statistics: Create (Cosmic, Essential, +50%; Transmute Paper to Essential Paper, +50%; Transmutation Only, -100%; Magical, -10%) [4.5/level*]. * Calculate the total cost then round up.

spells.description: When the caster reads a written work, whatever he reads comes to life in his head as if he were experiencing with all his senses. He is an observer, not a participant, so this is not dangerous, but can still call for a Fright Check.
spells.statistics: Mind Reading (Accessibility, Only on books, -50%; Sensory Only, -20%; Sorcery, -15%; Vision-Based, Variant, -20%) [6].

spells.description: If the victim fails to resist, he takes 1d-2 fatigue damage after which he feels a longing for a good book. This FP can only be recovered by a day of reading a work of literature that the person has never read before.
spells.statistics: Fatigue Attack 1d-2 (Will; Malediction 2, +150%; No Signature, +20%; Sorcery, ‑15%; Starvation, Variant, +40%) [12].

spells.casting_roll: None. Use Innate Attack (Gaze) to aim.
spells.description: This working raises the subject’s DX by 1 per level of the spell for one second. It cannot be used to increase a roll that represents several seconds of effort, such as a Regular Contest.
spells.statistics: Affliction 1 (HT; Advantage, Boost Dexterity 1, +180%; Fixed Duration, +0%; Increased 1/2D, x10, +15%; No Signature, +20%; Reduced Duration, 1/180, -40%; Reflexive, +40%; Sorcery, -15%) [30]. Notes: Each level of “Boost Dexterity” is DX 1 (Magical, -10%) [18]. Additional levels add additional levels of Boost Dexterity to the Advantage enhancement [+18].

spells.casting_roll: None. Use Innate Attack (Gaze) to aim.
spells.description: This working raises the subject’s HT by 1 per level of the spell for one second. It cannot be used to increase a roll that represents several seconds of effort, such as a Regular Contest.
spells.statistics: Affliction 1 (HT; Advantage, Boost Health 1, +60%; Fixed Duration, +0%; Increased 1/2D, x10, +15%; No Signature, +20%; Reduced Duration, 1/180, -40%; Reflexive, +40%; Sorcery, -15%) [18]. Notes: Each level of “Boost Health” is HT 1 (Does not increase FP, -30%; Magical, -10%) [6]. Additional levels add additional levels of Boost Health to the Advantage enhancement [+6].

spells.casting_roll: None. Use Innate Attack (Gaze) to aim.
spells.description: This working raises a sapient subject’s IQ by 1 per level of the spell for one second. It cannot be used to increase a roll that represents several seconds of effort, such as a Regular Contest.
spells.statistics: Affliction 1 (HT; Accessibility, Only on sapient beings, -10%; Advantage, Boost Intelligence 1, +180%; Fixed Duration, +0%; Increased 1/2D, x10, +15%; No Signature, +20%; Reduced Duration, 1/180, -40%; Reflexive, +40%; Sorcery, -15%) [29]. Notes: Each level of “Boost Intelligence” is IQ 1 (Magical, -10%) [18]. Additional levels add additional levels of Boost Intelligence to the Advantage enhancement [+18].

spells.casting_roll: None. Use Innate Attack (Gaze) to aim.
spells.description: This working raises the subject’s ST by 1 per level of the spell for one second. It cannot be used to increase a roll that represents several seconds of effort, such as a Regular Contest.
spells.statistics: Affliction 1 (HT; Advantage, Boost Strength 1, +70%; Fixed Duration, +0%; Increased 1/2D, x10, +15%; No Signature, +20%; Reduced Duration, 1/180, -40%; Reflexive, +40%; Sorcery, -15%) [19]. Notes: Each level of “Boost Strength” is ST 1 (Doesn’t Grant HP, -20%; Magical, -10%) [7]. Additional levels add additional levels of Boost Strength to the Advantage enhancement [+7].

spells.casting_roll: None. Use Innate Attack (Gaze) to aim.
spells.description: The subject’s temperature comfort zone (between 35° and 90° for humans) extends by HT degrees in both directions per level of this spell.
spells.statistics: Affliction 1 (HT; Advantage, Endure Elements 1, +20%; Extended Duration, 10x, +40%; Fixed Duration, +0%; Increased 1/2D, 10x, +15%; No Signature, +20%; Sorcery, -15%) [18]. Additional levels add further Endure Elements to Advantage (+20%) [+2]. Note: Each level of “Endure Elements” is Temperature Tolerance 2 (Magical, -10%) [2].

spells.casting_roll: None. Use Innate Attack (Gaze) to aim.
spells.description: The subject becomes able to glide through the air. He cannot gain altitude.
spells.statistics: Affliction 1 (HT; Advantage, Feather Fall, +160%; Fixed Duration, +0%; Increased 1/2D, 10x, +15%; No Signature, +20%; Sorcery, ‑15%) [28]. Note: “Feather Fall” is Flight (Gliding, -50%; Magical, -10%) [16].

spells.casting_roll: None. Use Innate Attack (Gaze) to aim.
spells.description: The subject gains and everything he carries an extra DR 10 against any sort of FP or HP damage incurred from energy, whether from a direct attack or an environmental effect.
spells.statistics: Affliction 1 (HT; Advantage, Resist Energy 1, +450%; Extended Duration, 10x, +40%; Fixed Duration, +0%; Increased 1/2D, 10x, +15%; No Signature, +20%; Sorcery, -15%) [61]. Each additional level adds more levels of Resist Energy to the Advantage (+450%) [+45]. Note: Each level of “Resist Energy” is DR 10 (Force Field, +20%; Limited, Energy, -20%; Magical, -10%) [45].

spells.casting_roll: None. Use Innate Attack (Gaze) to aim.
spells.description: This working grants the subject the ability to speak every language at Accented (or Native, if the subject has Language Talent), excluding alien languages. This spell includes alien languages, though the subject may need special technology (or the Mimicry advantage) to produce the correct sounds.
spells.statistics: Affliction 1 (HT; Advantage, Tongues, +560%; Extended Duration, 10x, +40%; Fixed Duration, +0%; Increased 1/2D, 10x, +15%; No Signature, +20%; Sorcery, -15%) [72]. Notes: “Tongues” is Omnilingual (Cosmic, Universal Translator, +50%; Magical, -10%) [56]. The improved version improves Omnilingual to Xeno-Omnilingual [+56]. The advantages may be found in Pyramid #3-54, page 29.

spells.description: The caster may tap into the mind of a sapient subject you can see or hear, and borrow their language. You gain a language at the subject’s comprehension level or Accented – whichever is less.
spells.statistics: Telepathic Learning 4 (Limited, One Language, -50%; Reduced Time 2, +40%; Sorcery, -15%; Vision- or Hearing-Based, -15%) [13].

spells.description: The caster may tap into the mind of a sapient subject you can see or hear, and borrow their knowledge. You can borrow the equivalent of 4 character points (e.g., if you learned a Hard skill, you would know it at IQ+0).
spells.statistics: Telepathic Learning 4 (Limited, One Skill, -10%; Reduced Time 2, +40%; Sorcery, -15%; Vision- or Hearing-Based, -15%) [21].

spells.description: The caster can set up a two-way conversation with another person. Range is theoretically unlimited, but the IQ roll to cast this spell takes the range penalties given under Long-Distance Modifiers.
spells.statistics: Mind Reading (Accessibility, Said words only, -20%; Link, +10%; Magical, -10%; Telecommunication, -20%) [18] + Telesend (Accessibility, Requires Words, -10%; Hearing-Based, -20%; Link, +10%; Sorcery, -15%; Visible, -10%) [17].

spells.description: The sapient subject becomes unable to tell a truth, though he may keep silent or tell partial truths (this must be roleplayed). The spell does not force him to volunteer incorrect information; he merely cannot say anything he believes to be true.
spells.statistics: Affliction 1 (Will; Accessibility, Only on sapient beings, -10%; Based on Will, +20%; Disadvantage, Compel Lie, +30%; Fixed Duration, +0%; Malediction 2, +150%; No Signature, +20%; Sorcery, -15%) [30]. Note: “Compel Lie” is Compulsive Lying (No Self-Control Roll, x2.5; Can keep silent, -20%) [-30].

spells.description: The sapient subject becomes unable to lie, though he may keep silent or tell partial truths (this must be roleplayed). The spell does not force him to volunteer information; he merely cannot say anything he believes to be untrue.
spells.statistics: Affliction 1 (Will; Accessibility, Only on sapient beings, -10%; Based on Will, +20%; Disadvantage, Compel Truth, +10%; Fixed Duration, +0%; Malediction 2, +150%; No Signature, +20%; Sorcery, -15%) [28]. Note: “Compel Truth” is Truthfulness (No Self-Control Roll, x2.5; Can keep silent, -20%) [-10].

spells.description: The sapient subject becomes unable to write a lie, though he may refuse to write or write partial truths (this must be roleplayed). The spell does not force him to volunteer information; he merely cannot write anything he believes to be untrue.
spells.statistics: Affliction 1 (Will; Accessibility, Only on sapient beings, -10%; Based on Will, +20%; Disadvantage, Compel Written Truth, +5%; Extended Duration, 10x, +40%; Fixed Duration, +0%; Malediction 2, +150%; No Signature, +20%; Sorcery, -15%) [31]. Note: “Compel Written Truth” is Truthfulness (No Self-Control Roll, x2.5; Can refuse to write, -20%; Written Only, -40%) [-5].

spells.casting_roll: None. Use Innate Attack (Gaze) to aim.
spells.duration: 30 minutes. For the duration, the subject is literate in one written language, chosen when you cast the spell. You do not have to be literate in the language – in fact, this is an excellent way to get around that problem! However, the GM is within rights to declare certain languages “secret” or “lost” and thus unavailable unless you first learn the language (to at least Broken) legitimately.
spells.description: For the duration, the subject is literate in one written language, chosen when you cast the spell. You do not have to be literate in the language – in fact, this is an excellent way to get around that problem!
spells.statistics: Affliction 1 (HT; Advantage, Gift of Letters, +120%; Extended Duration, 10x, +40%; Fixed Duration, +0%; Increased 1/2D, 10x, +15%; No Signature, +20%; Sorcery, -15%) [28]. Note: “Gift of Letters” is Cosmic Power 3 (Limited, One Written Language, -50%; Magical, -10%) [12].

spells.casting_roll: None. Use Innate Attack (Gaze) to aim.
spells.description: The subject’s mind becomes impossible to read and control.
spells.statistics: Affliction 1 (HT; Advantage, Hide Thoughts, +270%; Fixed Duration, +0%; Increased 1/2D, 10x, +15%; No Signature, +20%; Sorcery, -15%) [39]. Note: “Hide Thoughts” is Immunity to Mind Control (Magical, -10%) [27].

spells.casting_roll: None. Use Innate Attack (Gaze) to aim.
spells.duration: 30 minutes. It becomes easy for the subject to blend in. The subject’s face is hard to pick out or remember. They get +5 per level of the spell to Shadowing in crowds, while others have -5 per level of the spell to rolls made to recognize them from a lineup or mug shots – or even to recall meeting them!
spells.description: It becomes easy for the subject to blend in. The subject’s face is hard to pick out or remember.
spells.statistics: Affliction 1 (HT; Advantage, Insignificance, +190%; Extended Duration, 10x, +40%; Fixed Duration, +0%; Increased 1/2D, 10x, +15%; No Signature, +20%; Sorcery, -15%) [35]. Additional levels add more Insignificance to the Advantage enhancement (+190%) [+19]. Note: Each level of “Insignificance” is Obscure 5 (Memory; Defensive, +50%; Magical, -10%; No Area of Effect, -50%; Stealthy, +100%) [19].

spells.casting_roll: None. Use Innate Attack (Gaze) to aim.
spells.duration: 30 minutes. Subject gains a language (sapient creatures only) at the caster’s comprehension level or Accented – whichever is less. The caster must know the language in question.
spells.description: Subject gains a language (sapient creatures only) at the caster’s comprehension level or Accented – whichever is less. The caster must know the language in question.
spells.statistics: Affliction 1 (HT; Accessibility, Sapient Creatures Only, -10%; Advantage, Lend Language, +160%; Extended Duration, 10x, +40%; Fixed Duration, +0%; Increased 1/2D, 10x, +15%; No Signature, +20%; Sorcery, -15%) [31]. Note: “Lend Language” is Cosmic Power 4 (Limited, One Known Language, -50%; Magical, -10%) [16].

spells.casting_roll: None. Use Innate Attack (Gaze) to aim.
spells.duration: 30 minutes. Subject (sapient creatures only) gains a single skill the caster knows. Spells cannot be granted this way. The caster can lend the equivalent of 4 character points (e.g., if he lends a Hard skill, the subject would know it at IQ+0). The subject cannot have more points in the skill than the caster.
spells.description: Subject (sapient creatures only) gains a single skill the caster knows. Spells cannot be granted this way.
spells.statistics: Affliction 1 (HT; Accessibility, Sapient Creatures Only, -10%; Advantage, Lend Skill, +160%; Extended Duration, 10x, +40%; Fixed Duration, +0%; Increased 1/2D, 10x, +15%; No Signature, +20%; Sorcery, -15%) [31]. Note: “Lend Skill” is Cosmic Power 4 (Accessibility, Subject cannot have relative skill level better than the caster, -10%; Limited, One Skill, -40%; Magical, -10%) [16].

spells.casting_roll: None. Use Innate Attack (Gaze) to aim.
spells.duration: 30 minutes. It becomes hard for the subject to blend in. The subject’s face is easy to pick out or remember. They get -5 per level of the spell to Shadowing in crowds, while others have +5 per level of the spell to rolls made to recognize them from a lineup or mug shots – or even to recall meeting them!
spells.description: It becomes hard for the subject to blend in. The subject’s face is easy to pick out or remember.
spells.statistics: Affliction 1 (Will; Advantage, Presence, +190%; Based on Will, +20%; Extended Duration, 10x, +40%; Malediction 2, +150%; No Signature, +20%; Sorcery, -15%) [51]. Additional levels add more Presence to the Advantage enhancement (+190%) [+19]. Note: Each level of “Presence” is Obscure 5 (Memory; Defensive, +50%; Magical, -10%; No Area of Effect, -50%; Reversed, -0%; Stealthy, +100%) [19].

spells.duration: Instantaneous or 3 minutes. Causes a subject to re-experience an event from his past life (or lives!). This can be a torment or as a boon. Different kinds of memories have different effects. A terrifying memory requires a Fright Check at -3 or more; the memory of one’s violent death, for example (in a campaign where Resurrection is possible), requires a Fright Check at -5 (but no more). The memory of a wound or illness requires a HT roll; failure stuns the subject. A memory of slavery or degradation reduces Will by 1 for 3 minutes unless a Will roll is made. A memory of personal triumph and power increases Will by 1 for 3 minutes. The GM judges the effects of any other type of memory, but it should not impose a disadvantage worth more than -10 points or an advantage worth more than 5 points. The caster only specifies the type of event to be relived; he cannot use this spell to “rummage” through the memories of the subject.
spells.description: Causes a subject to re-experience an event from his past life (or lives!). This can be a torment or as a boon.
spells.statistics: Alternative Abilities [95]: Affliction 1 (Will or HT; Accessibility, Must be related to a memory, -20%; Advantage, Variable, +50%; Based on Will, +20%; Disadvantage, Variable, +10%; Fixed Duration, +0%; Malediction 2, +150%; No Signature, +20%; Selectivity, +10%; Sorcery, -15%) [33/5=7] + Terror 5 (Accessibility, Penalty depends on the severity of the memory, -30%; Active, +0%; Increased Range, 10x, +30%; Presence, +25%; Sorcery, -15%) [88].

spells.duration: Instantaneous. Perform a Quick Contest of caster's Will versus the subject’s IQ (or Fast-Talk or Acting skill, if appropriate). Success lets the caster pinpoint if a phrase spoken in the last five minutes by the subject was a lie, or if the last statement uttered by the subject was a lie, caster's choice. The caster can voluntarily penalize his casting roll; for each -1 penalty to the roll, he can reach an additional 5 minutes into the past.
spells.description: Perform a Quick Contest of caster's Will versus the subject’s IQ (or Fast-Talk or Acting skill, if appropriate). Success lets the caster pinpoint if a phrase spoken in the last five minutes by the subject was a lie, or if the last statement uttered by the subject was a lie, caster's choice.

spells.description: The caster may mentally dominate magical creations you can see or touch. To use this ability, concentrate for one second and then roll a Quick Contest: your IQ vs. your subject’s master’s Will.
spells.statistics: Mind Control (Accessibility, Only on magical creations, -50%; Based on master’s Will, +20%; Puppet, -40%; Sorcery, ‑15%) [10].

spells.duration: Hours equal to margin of success on the casting roll.Create an animal (IQ 5 or less) that does your mental bidding while it exists.
spells.description: The animal appears within the arm’s reach. A living creation must be identical to a real living being with which the caster is familiar.
spells.statistics: Ally (Animal; Built on 50%; Constantly, no roll required; Adjustable, Animals, +50%; Conjured, +100%; Magical, -10%; Maximum Duration, hours equal to margin of success, -5%; Minion, +50%; Requires Will Roll, -5%) [23]. Notes: The Maximum Duration limitation is priced based on Maximum Duration, 12 hours. As a special effect, this spell breaks sorcery rules by allowing free maintenance, but this is offset by imposing a FP cost to cast.

spells.duration: Hours equal to margin of success on the casting roll.Creates a stupid but obedient servitor (all attributes equal to 9) to do the caster’s bidding.
spells.description: The caster determines the servant’s appearance. The servant appears within the arm’s reach.

spells.description: The warrior appears within the arm’s reach. He has IQ 10; ST, DX, and HT 12; and skill 16 with any single weapon (or unarmed combat ability) the caster desires.
spells.statistics: Ally (Warrior; Built on 50%; Constantly, no roll required; Adjustable, Warriors, +25%; Conjured, +100%; Magical, -10%; Maximum Duration, hours equal to margin of success, -5%; Minion, +50%; Requires Will Roll, -5%) [21]. spells.description: You attempt to dispel a magical creation. Roll a Quick Contest of your Will versus the subject’s master’s Will.
spells.statistics: Affliction 1 (Master’s Will; Accessibility, Only on magical creations, -50%; Based on master’s Will, +20%; Disadvantage, Fragile (Enhanced Unnatural), +100%; Heart Attack, +300%; Malediction 2, +150%; No Signature, +20%; Sorcery, ‑15%) [63].

spells.casting_roll: IQ. May require other skills to make alterations. Special casting time (see below).
spells.duration: Indefinite. Like Create Object (GURPS Thaumatology - Sorcery, page 18), but with the following changes. This spell duplicates an actual item weighing 3 lbs. or less, which must be held or touched by you while the spell is cast; the duplicate appears in your hand. Note that (e.g.) “a loaded gun” would be a single object; you do not have to duplicate the gun and bullets separately! This permits a mage with no knowledge of Armoury to create a gun – if he has another one handy to copy. It also permits perfect forgeries of works of art, money, documents, and so on. The mage may also attempt to alter the creation. For instance, he could copy a sword and add inscribed runes, or forge a passport with a different name or picture, etc. In this case, normal rules for the caster’s abilities apply; Forgery skill rolls may be required. A mage with no knowledge of guns could gold-plate a duplicate, but he couldn’t modify the firing mechanism or ammunition capacity.
spells.description: Like Create Object, but with the following changes. This spell duplicates an actual item weighing 3 lbs.
spells.statistics: Snatcher (Cosmic, Allows alterations, +50%; Improved, +10%; Less Weight, 3 lbs., ‑5%; Magical, ‑10%; Reduced Fatigue Cost 1, +20%; Requires a sample object, -20%) [116]. Level 2 removes Less Weight (+5%) [+4] and additional levels add More Weight (+5%) [+4]. Note: The Improved enhancement eliminates the auto-fail on 14+.

spells.casting_roll: None. Use Innate Attack (Projectile) to hit.
spells.description: This working conjures a sticky glob of acid, which will adhere to and corrode any creature it strikes. This missile can be dodged or blocked.
spells.statistics: Corrosion Attack 1d-1 (Blockable, -5%; Cyclic, 9 cycles, 1 second intervals, +900%; Nuisance Effect, Dangerous to be parried, -5%; Sorcery, -15%) [69].

spells.casting_roll: None. Use DX or unarmed combat skill to hit.
spells.description: The caster must touch the subject to cast this spell. The subject begins to freeze from within, taking 1d-1 fatigue damage each second for 10 seconds, ignoring DR.
spells.statistics: Fatigue Attack 1d-1 (Accessibility, Only on living, -10%; Cosmic, Irresistible Attack, +300%; Cyclic, 9 cycles, 1 second intervals, Resistible, +450%; Freezing, +20%; Melee Attack, Reach C, Cannot Parry, -35%; Resistible, HT, -30%; Side Effect, DX-2 and Numb, +90%; Sorcery, -15%) [61].

spells.casting_roll: None. Use Innate Attack (Beam) to hit.
spells.description: You fire a coruscating discharge of electricity that does 1d-1 burning surge damage. The electric charge continues to jump and sparkle across the target’s body, damaging him again every second for 9 seconds.
spells.statistics: Burning Attack 1d-1 (Cosmic, Contagious Cycles, +50%; Cyclic, 9 cycles, 1 second intervals, +900%; Nuisance Effect, Behaves erratically around conductors, -5%; Sorcery, -15%; Surge, Arcing, +100%; Side Effect, Stunning, +50%) [48].

spells.statistics: Burning Attack 1d-1 (Blockable, -5%; Cyclic, 9 cycles, 1 second intervals, +900%; No Incendiary Effect, -10%; Nuisance Effect, Dangerous to be parried, -5%; Side Effect, DX-2 and Numb, +90%; Sorcery, -15%) [43].

spells.description: This working conjures a sticky glob of liquid fire, which will adhere to and burn any creature it strikes. This missile can be dodged or blocked.
spells.statistics: Burning Attack 1d-1 (Blockable, -5%; Cyclic, 9 cycles, 1 second intervals, +900%; Nuisance Effect, Dangerous to be parried, -5%; Sorcery, -15%) [39].

spells.description: This is a variant of Partial Shapeshifting that affects only one body part without preserving scale or function. Transforming a victim’s head into a diminutive insect head will kill him instantly, as such head will not provide enough brainpower to sustain the body.
spells.statistics: Affliction 1 (HT or Will; Disadvantage, Fragile (Enhanced Unnatural), +100%; Heart Attack, Variant, +300%; Malediction 2, +150%; No Signature, +20%; Nuisance Effect, Multiple ways to resist, -10%; Sorcery, ‑15%) [65]. Note: Fragile (Enhanced Unnatural) means the subject dies if reduced to 0 HP; therefore, since Heart Attack reduces the target’s HP to 0, the target dies.

spells.description: This working affects anything with a soul and causes the caster to swap bodies with the subject, then shifts the caster’s mind into a mindless vessel in the environment (stone, tree, or similar), and then swaps the caster’s consciousness back into his original body while moving the subject’s to the object.
spells.statistics: Affliction 1 (Will; Accessibility, Only on beings with a soul, -5%; Based on Will, +20%; Coma, Variant, +250%; Malediction 2, +150%; No Signature, +20%; Nuisance Effect, Critical Failure, -50%; Sorcery, ‑15%) [47].

spells.casting_roll: None. Use Innate Attack (Gaze) to aim.
spells.duration: Three minutes. Turns a melee weapon or a round of ammunition (e.g., arrow or bullet) into a vehicle of death. Cannot be cast on a missile weapon such as a bow or a gun – only on its ammo. Any living being hit be an Assassin’s Weapon must resist with HT. Failure means a fatal wound causing immediate death, however improbable. Check for the weapon’s mundane effects (penetration, wounding, etc.) only after the resistance roll.
spells.description: Turns a melee weapon or a round of ammunition (e.g., arrow or bullet) into a vehicle of death. Cannot be cast on a missile weapon such as a bow or a gun – only on its ammo.

spells.description: This working painlessly slaughters an animal and then separates the carcass into handy packages. Subjects with IQ 5 or less resist with HT.
spells.statistics: Affliction 1 (HT; Accessibility, Only on living creatures, -10%; Disadvantage, Fragile (Enhanced Unnatural), +100%; Heart Attack, +300%; Link, +10%; Malediction 2, +150%; No Signature, +20%; Nuisance Effect, IQ Bonuses to resistance rolls, -20%; Sorcery, ‑15%) [64] + Telekinesis 1 (Link, +10%; Magical, -10%; One Task, Prepare Game, -60%; Reduced Time 10, +200%) [12]. Note: See GURPS Thaumatology: Sorcery, p. 14 for the One Task limitation. Here, Reduced Time is used to shorten a 10-minute process to one second, which was chosen because it costs the same as an Average technique to buy off the -10 for “instant use.”

spells.casting_roll: None. Use Innate Attack (Gaze) to aim.
spells.duration: Permanent. Introduces a deadly physical poison into food. This poison remains indefinitely, but can be detected by Test Food. Anyone eating the poisoned food must make a HT roll. On a failed roll, he is seized by painful stomach cramps, taking 8d toxic damage; he is at -3 to DX and IQ for 1 hour. The poison is not magical, Magic Resistance does not help.
spells.description: Introduces a deadly physical poison into food. This poison remains indefinitely, but can be detected by Test Food.
spells.statistics: Affliction 1 (HT; Accessibility, Can only be cast into food, -30%; Advantage, Death’s Banquet, +570%; Extended Duration, Permanent, +150%; Fixed Duration, +0%; Increased 1/2D, 10x, +15%; No Signature, +20%; Sorcery, -15%) [81]. spells.duration: Instantaneous. Attempts to send some of the subject to another place, time, or plane of existence. The target resists with the better of HT or Will. Failure means random chunks go elsewhere. This is instantly fatal! This spell can affect anyone with a physical body. Subjects who have the Duplication advantage and an unused Dupe can sacrifice one copy to ensure the survival of the rest. This is instead of trying to resist. It costs a Dupe but guarantees survival. If this spell critically fails, the caster becomes the point of arrival for a Dimensional Dissection spell cast elsewhere in creation. A forceful jet of gore with roughly half the mass of his intended subject blasts him for dice of crushing damage equal to the would-be victim’s HP/2, rounded up. No active defense is possible.
spells.description: Attempts to send some of the subject to another place, time, or plane of existence. The target resists with the better of HT or Will.
spells.statistics: Affliction 1 (HT or Will; Accessibility, Only on beings with a physical body, -5%; Disadvantage, Fragile (Enhanced Unnatural), +100%; Heart Attack, Variant, +300%; Malediction 2, +150%; No Signature, +20%; Nuisance Effect, Backlash, -30%; Nuisance Effect, Multiple ways to resist, -10%; Sorcery, ‑15%) [61].

spells.description: This working causes a subject made mostly of water (living beings that require water – humans, elves, animals, trees, fungi, etc., flesh golems, water elementals, rotting undead, wet nanotech robots) to lose structural integrity, melting to thick fluid.
spells.statistics: Affliction 1 (HT; Accessibility, Only on water-based lifeforms, -20%; Disadvantage, Fragile (Enhanced Unnatural), +100%; Heart Attack, Variant, +300%; Malediction 2, +150%; No Signature, +20%; Nuisance Effect, Can be reversed, -10%; Sorcery, ‑15%) [63]. Note: Fragile (Enhanced Unnatural) means the subject dies if reduced to 0 HP; therefore, since Heart Attack reduces the target’s HP to 0, the target dies.

spells.description: You fill the subject’s lungs with water. The subject loses his ability to breathe or speak for 30 seconds.
spells.statistics: Affliction 1 (HT; Accessibility, Not on water-breathers, -10%; Choking, +100%; Fixed Duration, +0%; Malediction 2, +150%; No Signature, +20%; Reduced Duration, 1/6, -15%; Sorcery, 15%) [33].

spells.casting_roll: None. Use Innate Attack (Beam) to aim.
spells.duration: 10 seconds. Conjures a beautiful flower to hand that belches forth a jet of deadly pollen. You may fill a two-yard-radius area with deadly pollen. To place the pollen cloud at a distance, use Innate Attack (Beam), with normal range penalties, but at +4 for affecting an area. The initial attack roll places the effect. It then drifts from that point with the wind. Every creature in the area experiences a fatal allergic reaction on a failed HT roll. Treat this as a mortal wound (p. B423): The target instantly falls unconscious and must roll vs. HT every 30 minutes, with any failure meaning death. At TL6+, trauma maintenance can help. Natural recovery occurs on a critical success on the HT roll. Otherwise, the only cure is suitable TL6+ medication or a Neutralize Poison spell, at -5 unless Identify Plant is cast first to determine what pollen caused the reaction. The deadly pollen is a contact agent that affects any living being without the Sealed advantage (natural or from equipment) and/or Immunity to Metabolic Hazards. Magic Resistance provides no benefit – no magic is cast on the victim. If your foe is within one yard of you, he may attempt to parry this attack (actually parrying your hand). If such a parry is successful, you must roll against DX to avoid placing the effect in your own hex!
spells.description: Conjures a beautiful flower to hand that belches forth a jet of deadly pollen. You may fill a two-yard-radius area with deadly pollen.
spells.statistics: Affliction 1 (HT; Area Effect, 2 yards, +50%; Coma, Variant, +250%; Contact Agent, +150%; Drifting, +20%; Increased 1/2D, 10x, +15%; Nuisance Effect, Dangerous to be parried, -5%; Persistent, +40%; Reduced Range, 1/10, -30%; Sorcery, -15%) [58].

spells.duration: Instantaneous. Transforms any living subject to organic gunk – similar to the Body of Slime spell, but without stabilizing the results. The subject’s remaining possessions are left floating in a puddle of scum, which may ruin some gear. Remove Curse can reverse it if the victim’s residue is collected within a minute (doubtful if the subject was standing on anything but hard, dry ground like stone or finished wood). This must be cast before the stuff dies, which won’t take long in any environment that isn’t rich in rotting organic matter. The GM may require daily Biology or Naturalist rolls from the slime’s caretaker.
spells.description: Transforms any living subject to organic gunk – similar to the Body of Slime spell, but without stabilizing the results. The subject’s remaining possessions are left floating in a puddle of scum, which may ruin some gear.

Note: Fragile (Enhanced Unnatural) means the subject dies if reduced to 0 HP; therefore, since Heart Attack reduces the target’s HP to 0, the target dies.

spells.duration: Instantaneous. Attempts to directly and fatally overload even the most rudimentary of brains. This spell is effective against any physical IQ 1+ entity! The subject may resist using the better of HT (brain) or Will (mind). If the victim fails to resist, the brain is burned out, its functions suspended and memories deleted. The victim collapses immediately. The body lives on for HT/3 minutes, but the person is gone barring an Instant Restoration spell cast within that window of opportunity.
spells.description: Attempts to directly and fatally overload even the most rudimentary of brains. This spell is effective against any physical IQ 1+ entity!

spells.description: This transforms the subject into a seething swarm of small, mindless creatures for 1 second. The magic is highly unstable and doesn’t impart a group mind – rather than stay in a cohesive horde, the critters crawl, fly, or swim in all directions.
spells.statistics: Affliction 1 (Will; Based on Will, +20%; Disadvantage, Fragile (Enhanced Unnatural), +100%; Heart Attack, Variant, +300%; Malediction 2, +150%; No Signature, +20%; Nuisance Effect, Victim can be saved with Insect Control, -10%; Sorcery, ‑15%) [67]. Note: Fragile (Enhanced Unnatural) means the subject dies if reduced to 0 HP; therefore, since Heart Attack reduces the target’s HP to 0, the target dies.

spells.duration: Instantaneous. Determines whether the subject (person, object, or area) is under the effects of a curse. Curses are supernatural negative effects that cannot be removed via Dispel Magic or an equivalent of a different power source, and require a specific spell or ability (Remove Curse, Stone to Flesh, etc.) to dispel. The GM will secretly roll against the caster’s IQ minus range penalties (p. B550) to the subject, which the caster must be able to see or touch. If the sorcerer is familiar with the curse in question, this will reveal them. Otherwise, the GM will use the margin of success to determine how much information to give the sorcerer.
spells.description: Determines whether the subject (person, object, or area) is under the effects of a curse. Curses are supernatural negative effects that cannot be removed via Dispel Magic or an equivalent of a different power source, and require a specific spell or ability (Remove Curse, Stone to Flesh, etc.) to dispel.
spells.statistics: Detect (Curse; Sorcery, -15%; Touch- or Vision-Based, -15%) [7].

spells.description: you can immediately sense all nearby scrying or remote sensors, sorted by the direction to each one. This will detect the presence of a scrying effect and will tell you the direction to the point from which the scryer is viewing you.
spells.statistics: Detect (Remote Viewing; Cannot Analyze, -10%; Sorcery, -15%) [4]. The improved version adds Precise (+100%) [+5].

spells.description: you can immediately sense all nearby primitive traps, such as snares, tripwires, and camouflaged pits, sorted by the direction to each one. It won’t detect anything more complex.
spells.statistics: Detect (Primitive Traps; Cannot Analyze, -10%; Sorcery, -15%) [4]. The improved version adds Precise (+100%) [+5].

spells.description: When faced with a number of alternatives, and no logical way to choose among them, you can cast this spell. On a success, he steers you to a good choice; on a critical success, he tells you the best choice.
spells.statistics: Intuition (Sorcery, -15%) [13].

spells.description: When cast on a subject that fails to resist, this spell grants the caster the subject’s True Name. Points must be spent to buy a perk to remember a True Name, but the perk allows its use with other spells, if the system in question allows that.
spells.statistics: Detect (True Name; Analyzing, +100%; Analysis Only, -50%; Easily Resisted 10, -50%; Requires IQ vs. Will Roll, -10%; Sorcery, -15%; Touch- or Vision-Based, -15%) [18].

spells.description: The caster may displace your sight to a point outside your body. Your ability is reflexive.
spells.statistics: Clairsentience (Clairvoyance, -10%; Fixed Range, -5%; Second Nature, +70%; Sorcery, -15%) [70].

spells.duration: Instantaneous. By touching a stone, you can force it to answer any one specific question that it can answer with a brief sentence. To attempt a probe, you must first touch the stone, concentrate for one second, and make an IQ roll. You have to vocally ask the question, and the stone responds in the same language. The stone cannot resist, but your IQ (plus Talent) roll is at a penalty equal to the stone’s SM, and you only get one try. If you win, you give the stone a semblance of life and force it to give you the answer. The answer is what the stone believes to be true – if it doesn’t know, it’ll tell you. A stone’s perspective, perception, and knowledge may prevent the stone from providing the details you are looking for.
spells.description: By touching a stone, you can force it to answer any one specific question that it can answer with a brief sentence. To attempt a probe, you must first touch the stone, concentrate for one second, and make an IQ roll.
spells.statistics: Mind Probe (Accessibility, Only on stones, -50%; Cosmic, Works on inanimate objects, +50%; Requires Words, -10%; Sorcery, -15%; Universal, +50%) [25]. Feature: Size penalty replaces the normal Quick Contest.

spells.casting_roll: None. Use Innate Attack (Projectile) to aim.

spells.statistics: Cutting Attack 1d+1 (Area Effect, 2 yards, +50%; Bombardment, Skill-12, -10%; Overhead, +30%; Sorcery, -15%; Variable, Area, +5%) [16]. Additional levels add more Area Effect (+50%) [+5].

spells.casting_roll: None. Use Innate Attack (Projectile) to aim.
